name: Just Screenshotter
hint: Drag to select an area. Esc closes the editor.
film.deaf: No audio device was found, so system audio is not recorded.
broken: The editor did not open. Esc closes the window. {reason}
server.title: Upload by link
server.intro: Screenshots go to your own server, and the link is copied to the clipboard. The button appears in the editor.
server.kept: A key is saved. Type a new one to replace it
settings.unfit: Add Ctrl, Alt or another modifier key
settings.busy: Keys marked with “!” are used by another program.
settings.cost: While the program listens for mouse buttons, moving the mouse uses a little processor time.
tab.refused: The browser does not let extensions take pictures of this page.
tab.gone: The picture is gone. Take it again.
tab.long: The page is too long: the picture shows only its beginning.
error.settings: The settings could not be read, so the defaults are used. ({reason})
error.key: Another program uses {key}. Choose other keys in the settings.
error.clash: The same keys or buttons are chosen for two actions.
error.busy: Another program uses {key}. Nothing has changed.
error.shortcut: Add a shortcut with the command just-screenshotter in the keyboard settings.
error.locked: Windows does not let the program see the screen. The session may be locked.
error.permission: macOS does not let the program see the screen. Allow screen recording in the privacy settings.
error.film: Recording stopped. {reason} What was recorded before that is in the screenshots folder.
error.voice: The microphone cannot be used. Check that it is connected and allowed in the privacy settings. ({reason})
error.media: Windows has no Media Foundation, which makes video files. In Windows N, install the Media Feature Pack.
error.gstreamer: Video needs GStreamer. Install the packages gstreamer1.0-tools, gstreamer1.0-plugins-good and gstreamer1.0-pipewire.
error.picture: This is not a picture, so the file was not written.
error.clipboard: Another program is using the clipboard.
error.noserver: Set the server address and the key in the settings.
error.address: The address must start with https://
error.link: The server answered with something that is not a link. Check the address.
error.refused: The server does not accept the key.
error.nowhere: The server does not accept screenshots at this address.
error.large: The screenshot is too large for the server.
